what: Planned strict parsing of only *-vote-output.txt voter filenames conflicts with existing phase2/phase3 waterfall outputs and the main-agent fallback voter file
scenario_or_breakage: Codex/Cursor voter fallback can produce codex-vote-output-phase2.txt or codex-vote-output-phase3.txt, and 0-judge adjudication reruns tally with voter-main-agent.txt; the proposed tally would error before producing normal accepted/rejected/OOS artifacts
suggested_fix: Normalize known phase suffixes before deriving the slot, or pass explicit voter slot metadata into tally-plan-review.sh; define the main-agent voter mapping explicitly, and add harness cases for phase2/phase3 paths plus voter-main-agent.txt

what: The plan changes several existing scripts but omits required sibling contract updates
scenario_or_breakage: The repo rule requires updating sibling .md files in the same PR as behavior changes; stale contracts for tally-plan-review.sh, plan-review-loop.sh, design-log-publish.sh, render-voter-prompt.sh, lib-voter-parse-rate.sh, and touched harnesses will leave CLI/artifact/prompt behavior undocumented
suggested_fix: Add UPDATED entries and concrete edits for the affected sibling .md files, including new argv, TSV artifact paths/schema, publish allowlist behavior, prompt line shape, retry prefix line shape, and harness coverage

what: The parser contract is internally inconsistent about axis-value case handling
scenario_or_breakage: It says axis values are matched case-insensitively while also preserving verbatim case, but the stdout schema only allows lowercase enum values; an input like SEVERITY=MAJOR could emit an off-schema TSV cell if preserved
suggested_fix: Choose one contract: either require lowercase and treat other case as unrecognized, or accept case-insensitively and normalize every emitted PARSED_* value to the canonical lowercase enum
